name: easy-git
description: Client GitHub visuel avec terminal intégré pour débutants
author: Sébastien Gaudy (Lumenia Web Studio)

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && pnpm exec esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: pnpm run build && pnpm exec esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:node-pty --outfile=dist-server/index.cjs && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && pnpm exec esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs && electron-builder
